timeline.title: Graph Transformations Animator
timeline.summary: Created a pygame tool that animates function transformations.
timeline.description: A Python + pygame application that animates graph transformations (shifts, stretches, reflections) for arbitrary functions. Developed as a part of my A-Level Computer Science coursework for use by my school in teaching.

timeline.title: EasyAsPi & PrimeTime
timeline.summary: Developed apps to memorise Pi and Primes as part of my self-taught SwiftUI course.
timeline.description: Developed apps to memorise Pi and Primes as part of my self-taught SwiftUI course. They were created alongside a course by HackingWithSwift. Added to the app store once I became 18.

timeline.title: Somerset Guitar Works
timeline.summary: Developed a website for a second-hand guitar business with E-commerce integration.
timeline.description: Built a Squarespace storefront with custom animations, product listing pages and tag-based filtering.

timeline.title: PocketQuotes & PocketFacts
timeline.summary: Two iOS specialised notes apps built with SwiftUI and SwiftData.
timeline.description: Two iOS specialised notes apps built with SwiftUI and SwiftData. Used to collect, tag and search through facts and quotes that you have collected over time. I built these as I wanted a purpose built way of storing facts and quotes that I could easily retrieve in conversation.

timeline.title: Secondary School Graduation & A-Level Results
timeline.summary: Finished Secondary School with A-Level qualifications in Maths, CS & Bio
timeline.description: Finished Secondary School with A-Level qualifications in Mathematics, Further Mathematics, Computer Science & Biology. Achieved A*A*A*A with the A in Biology. Also received an A* for my EPQ with full marks.

timeline.title: University of St Andrews
timeline.description: Starting a degree at the University of St Andrews, taking Mathematics and Computer Science modules.
